quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the stress of his basketball career
quotes.excerpt: add more stress to your life when you're almost at the end of your basketball career
quotes.quote: I don't know whose stupid idea it was to start a golf YouTube channel. I don't know who it was. I don't know whose stupid idea it was to do this. Add more stress to your life when you're almost at the end of your basketball career to lessen the stress in your life. Now you have this game, then you get more stressed out.

quotes.speaker: Randy Mims
quotes.summary_phrase: Randy Mims on the significance of LeBron's innovation center
quotes.excerpt: to stand in his building is like, incredible
quotes.quote: The LeBron James Innovation Center, to stand in his building is like, incredible. So that's one of the big pieces of this trip is just to come back and see, you know, from day one to now, all that he's accomplished to be able to have his own building here.

quotes.speaker: Elliott Hill
quotes.summary_phrase: Elliott Hill on LeBron James' professionalism at Nike
quotes.excerpt: he brings a level of professionalism to everybody, makes everybody up their game
quotes.quote: I think it's huge for the relationship just to have him here. He brings a level of professionalism to everybody, makes everybody up their game and we're just excited to have him here, all around.

quotes.speaker: Marquis Hall
quotes.summary_phrase: Marquis Hall on the research and innovation at Nike
quotes.excerpt: the level of research, technology, innovation that's in this building is second to none
quotes.quote: The level of research, technology, innovation that's in this building is second to none. Our team here do a great job of trying to make sure all this research goes into the product and and brings us product that helps our athletes.

quotes.speaker: Lynn Merritt
quotes.summary_phrase: Lynn Merritt on LeBron James as a Nike athlete
quotes.excerpt: he's proven over time to be one of the greatest athletes that Nike's ever had
quotes.quote: LeBron is proven over time to be one of the greatest athletes that Nike's ever had. He takes care of his body and that's what this place is all about.

quotes.speaker: Ted Curvy
quotes.summary_phrase: Ted Curvy on LeBron James' pursuit of excellence
quotes.excerpt: that's what LeBron is all about, and I think it's just fitting that this building is named after him
quotes.quote: It's about innovation, taking care of your body, doing what's best to be the best and, you know, reach your maximum potential. And that's what LeBron is all about, and I think it's just fitting that this building is named after him, as one of the world's greatest athletes.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James reflects on the golf match outcome against Creech and Lynn
quotes.excerpt: It didn't end well for the good guys today. Two-v-two shamble between me and Ramo, versus Creech and Lynn.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: It didn't end well for the good guys today. Two-v-two shamble between me and Ramo, versus Creech and Lynn. They got the best of us. They won by five. They won by five in match play, which is actually a lot. We owed them a little some funds. My partner is not doing too well, slumped over. Sad days for the good guys, but we will be back, better and stronger.
